title: Exact weighted GCD verification of the Family 059 product relation
predecessor_credit: OpenAI: finite product lemma, supplied relation and trial-division validator. Pico / Håkon Åmdal: preceding exact sieve and modular checks. No new counterexample or missing-proof repair claimed.
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in checker implementation, proof explanation, testing, prose, packaging and one scoped separate AI review. AI review is not human peer review.
claim: The supplied 849-coefficient relation at d=3^11 has admissible support, positive coefficient sum E, and both products of Lemma seed:product equal one. A compressed weighted GCD implementation verifies these exact identities without factoring or expanded enormous powers.

mathematical_scope.evidence: Complete finite arithmetic verification with a written algorithm soundness and termination proof.

public_disclosure.meaning: Dated public PR containing the completed result; the earlier issue was a coordination claim.

upstream_acceptance.review_kind: Maintainer AI replay, not human peer review

additional_evidence.finding: Coefficient swap seed59, indices229and86, preserves E, sum_abs and support; GCD rejects with26 residual bases and sieve with9/21 nonzero valuations. Reported independently by maintainer.

verification.dependencies: Python standard library; Bash for reproduction.
verification.expected: Exit 0 and RESULT: Family 059 exact GCD cancellation and rejecting controls reproduced
verification.reviewer_oracle_domain: Three ordered bases in 1..10; each of six exponent components in {-1,0,1}.
verification.review: One scoped separate AI review; no blocker found. Reviewer oracle is small-domain exhaustive testing, not a second complete witness verifier.

archival_staging.packaging_review: Separate scoped AI packaging review; no blocker. This review is distinct from the earlier arithmetic review and is not human peer review.

license: Archival compilation and archive note Apache-2.0; original contribution code/prose MIT; included OpenAI source Apache-2.0, with component notices preserved.
limitations: No new mathematical counterexample or global novelty claim.
The rank proof, witness-generation artifacts, chains, variable counts, spectra, Seifert forms, monodromy and homeomorphism theorem are outside scope.
Python and the arithmetic implementation remain trusted; not a Lean or other kernel proof.
Finite small-domain oracle checks do not prove all possible implementations or unrestricted input claims.

publication_history.archival_status: No standalone DOI deposit prepared in this bounded audit. The exact public source commit is citable; any later coherent archive should use a single version family after a duplicate search.
